# docsrs-cli
> One-shot stdin/stdout CLI for crates.io and docs.rs documentation for LLM agents.

docsrs-cli is a born-execute-finalize-die binary that searches crates, fetches README overviews and typed rustdoc items, and emits stable JSON envelopes on stdout with diagnostics only on stderr. Current release line is 1.2.x (release 1.2.0) with method fail-closed (`#method.X` missing → `not_found` exit 66), error envelopes carrying `command`+`duration_ms`, hard-max budget fail-closed (exit 65), ranked `--match` modes, effective-URL `--page-token` echo, cascade `--suggest` (method leaves from parent page), hyphen path normalize, rustdoc chrome scrub, doctor `ok` parity, timeout-0 fail-closed, `schema --cmd all` (19 wire names), and `data.cache_hit`.

## Optional
- [get-item schema](docs/schemas/get-item.schema.json): item_name, resolved_version, extraction=method on success, cache_hit
- [search-in-crate schema](docs/schemas/search-in-crate.schema.json): match_mode, score, cache_hit
- [search-crates schema](docs/schemas/search-crates.schema.json): page tokens, effective echo, cache_hit
- [readme schema](docs/schemas/readme.schema.json): resolved_version and cache_hit
- [schema meta](docs/schemas/schema.schema.json): embedded schema document payload
- [completions schema](docs/schemas/completions.schema.json): shell + script JSON mode
- [error schema](docs/schemas/error.schema.json): command, duration_ms, budget kind, retryable flag
- [dry-run schema](docs/schemas/dry-run.schema.json): planned_url, validation, planned_params.crate_name
